name: Malta College of Arts, Science and Technology
summary: Vocational college in Paola, taught in English, with 42 full-time bachelor's (Honours) in its 2026/27 list; free for EU students.

ib.text: Entry is set course by course (e.g. an MCAST Level 4 Advanced Diploma, or A-level and I-level passes). An IB Diploma is a non-Maltese qualification and needs an MQRIC statement; ask MCAST if your results meet a course.

apply.via: MCAST admissions portal (Maltese eID or eIDAS login)

programmes.name: Marine Engineering
programmes.about: Three years on how the engines and machinery of ships and marine installations are built, run and maintained, with emerging technologies, a work placement, and roles such as marine technologist or marine surveyor.
programmes.ib: MCAST asks for two A-level passes (Physics and Maths compulsory) plus two I-level passes, or its Advanced Diploma. It sets no IB grades; you need an MQRIC statement.

needs.note: MCAST says A-level; the MQRIC statement sets the IB equivalent
MCAST says A-level; the MQRIC statement sets the IB equivalent

programmes.selectionNote: The course page states no selection method; entry is set by the qualifications above. Ask MCAST how your IB results are read.

flagshipSource.title: Institute of Engineering and Transport: 64 courses in 8 departments, including the Centre for Maritime Studies

programmes.name: Cybersecurity
programmes.about: Three years on securing software, computer systems and networks: open-source operating systems, network security, digital forensics and offensive security, with work-based learning and an applied dissertation.
programmes.ib: MCAST asks for Computing at A-level plus Maths or Physics, with two I-level passes, or its Advanced Diploma in IT. It sets no IB grades; you need an MQRIC statement.

needs.note: MCAST says A-level; the MQRIC statement sets the IB equivalent
MCAST says A-level or I-level; the MQRIC statement sets the IB equivalent

programmes.selectionNote: The course page states no selection method; entry is set by the qualifications above. Ask MCAST how your IB results are read.

flagshipSource.title: Institute of ICT: 17 courses from certificate to master's level, including six bachelor's degrees

programmes.name: Game Art
programmes.about: Three years training digital artists for game production: art and design principles plus game-creation software, ending in a joint game project with Interactive Digital Media students.
programmes.ib: MCAST asks for two A-levels (Art compulsory) plus two I-levels, or an Advanced Diploma in Digital Design or Art and Design. No IB grades are set; get an MQRIC statement.

needs.note: MCAST says A-level; the MQRIC statement sets the IB equivalent

programmes.selectionNote: A portfolio and/or an interview may be required; the page does not say which applicants.

flagshipSource.title: Institute for the Creative Arts: 31 courses across art and design, media, fashion and performing arts

faculties.name: Institute of Applied Sciences
faculties.line: Science, nursing and agriculture degrees: an MCAST Advanced Diploma or A-level and I-level passes; some courses need medical clearance.

faculties.name: Institute of Business Management and Commerce
faculties.line: Three business degrees; Business Enterprise wants an A-level in Accounts, Marketing or Economics, or an MCAST Advanced Diploma.

faculties.name: Institute for the Creative Arts
faculties.line: Art, design, media and performing arts degrees; Art at A-level for Game Art, and a portfolio or interview may be asked for.

faculties.name: Institute of Community Services
faculties.line: Early years, inclusive education, social care and sport degrees; work placements need conduct, vaccination and first-aid checks.

faculties.name: Institute of Engineering and Transport
faculties.line: Engineering and construction degrees; Marine Engineering asks for Physics and Maths at A-level, or an MCAST Advanced Diploma.

faculties.name: Institute of Information and Communication Technology
faculties.line: Six computing degrees; Cybersecurity asks for Computing at A-level plus Maths or Physics, or an MCAST Advanced Diploma in IT.

notes: MCAST says its courses are free for Maltese and EU candidates; non-EU candidates pay per-level fees.
Applicants with qualifications not awarded by a Maltese institution need an MQRIC statement for each one, plus B2 English (for example IELTS 5.5) unless an English-language qualification covers it.
Most degrees are vocational with work-based learning; Performing Arts adds an interview and audition, and some courses need medical clearance.
